GPTR-F-001-S104.title: API Enforcement Wrapper for GPTReader Endpoint
GPTR-F-001-S104.description: Wrap GPTReader Azure Function endpoint with enforcement middleware that validates every incoming request against the allowlist schema and enforcement engine before any database interaction occurs.

GPTR-F-001-S105.title: Allowlist Enforcement Test Suite
GPTR-F-001-S105.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering valid requests, blocked queries, edge cases (nested queries, large payloads), and security bypass attempts to ensure enforcement cannot be circumvented.

GPTR-F-001-S106.title: Mandatory Enforcement Integration in Execution Pipeline
GPTR-F-001-S106.description: Integrate allowlist enforcement into GPTReader execution flow such that no query execution path exists without passing validation, including direct function calls and internal reuse paths.

GPTR-F-001.mitigation: Enforce validation as a mandatory pre-execution step with no bypass paths and full test coverage.
